description:
﻿SAIC has 2 immediate openings on a newly awarded contract for Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts to perform in a Systems Engineering and Technical Assistant (SETA) role and support operational, engineering, and research related activities. Successful candidates will be Subject Matter Experts in AI, especially frontier models and will understand the economic impacts of AI.  Candidates will also have experience with AI research, emerging model types, and other related dependencies in order to understand counter-AI.  The SETA must be adaptable, resilient under pressure, and capable of operating both independently and in team settings.


 Must currently hold a TS/SCI clearance and active polygraph in order to be considered.
 Bachelor's Degree or experience can be substituted for the degree.
 At least 5 years of post-graduate technical expertise in artificial intelligence or a closely related field.
 Minimum of 9 years of relevant systems engineering experience.
 Must currently hold a TS/SCI clearance and active polygraph in order to be considered.
 At least 5 years of demonstrated experience within the Intelligence Community and working across multiple IC components and DoW.
 In-depth technical knowledge in one or more of the following areas:
o    Applications of frontier models.
o    Economics of frontier-model applications.
o    Foreign frontier AI models, particularly open-source models.
o    Experience working in or with AI research laboratories.
o    Emerging AI model types and domains.
o    Adversarial or counter-artificial intelligence.
o    Other frontier AI research areas.
 
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
